about: The owner said the docs must be for humans: well written like a book, plain enough for a non-technical reader, with no [n]-style references; relations and decisions are kept only for the agents. Every agent layer gets the same set of docs (How it works, a feature map and other topic docs) with its own specifics, read from the common picture down to single files. Confirm the plan, show one example iteration, then continue; look for writing skills to add.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
